title: Canary Action Surface Narrowing
claim: FP-MCP-314 narrowed the guarded canary action surface in the MCP bridge by default. Adjacent manual canary gate tools are no longer registered unless FORGEPILOT_CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED=0 is set. Bridge commit 0c2d3cb contains the implementation.
summary: The MCP bridge repository feature/oauth-auth0 advanced from 5a75db7 to 0c2d3cb with commit 'Narrow guarded canary action surface'. The change adds CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED, defaulting to true unless FORGEPILOT_CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED=0. When narrow mode is active, the bridge does not register manual adjacent canary tools for execution preflight, guarded start preflight report, runner start, execution gate orientation, local clearance preview/create, scoped enablement preview/create/status. The enforced executor forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate remains registered. pnpm test passed, including TypeScript build and hardcoded packet-id lint.
caveats: The MCP service must be restarted or actions refreshed before the narrowed action surface is visible in chat.
The individual lower-level tools still exist in source and can be exposed by setting FORGEPILOT_CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED=0 for development/debugging.
This packet did not run the canary.
This packet did not create approval, clearance, enablement, or contact runner start.

structuredRecord.safetyPurpose: Reduce wrong-adjacent-tool selection by making the enforced executor the only exposed canary continuation path by default.
structuredRecord.nextRecommendedPacket: FP-MCP-315: restart or refresh actions, verify adjacent canary tools disappear, then use enforced executor only.
